claim_scope: ODS eager open: no statistic accepted; withheld as neutral

protocol.processes: one fresh process per A/B/B/A leg; samples within each leg run in-process
protocol.acceptance: a statistic is accepted only when candidate elapsed time is lower in both paired directions and control/candidate same-implementation drift stays within that statistic's threshold
protocol.percentiles: p50 = statistics.median; p95/p99 = nearest-rank (tools/perf_compare.py method); drift = (second_leg - first_leg) / first_leg

binaries.note: both binaries contain changes 0192-0196, 0198, and 0199 as baseline plus the identical selector matrix; the candidate binary additionally folds the content.xml structural validation pass into the 0200 fused open tokenization; control is the 0200 v2 binary

provenance.source_state: HEAD 9b717bb08 plus the uncommitted changes 0192-0196 and 0198-0200 (both binaries) plus the uncommitted validate-pass fold into the fused open parse (candidate binary only)

rejected_statistics.p99: paired directions disagree; candidate drift +17.66% exceeds 15%

verification: harness-embedded corpus hash identical across legs; in-harness semantic/read-evidence gates passed on every leg (a failed gate aborts the leg with a non-zero exit)
